en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside town with historic buildings along the bank, a bridge crossing the river, and a paddle steamer moored near the bridge. On the hill above the town stands a large castle complex and a Gothic cathedral with multiple tall spires. The river dominates the foreground with reflections of the structures. Decorative script text is printed in German along the bottom margin.
